# Ashmita Vinyls

> India's premier manufacturer and supplier of industrial PVC strip curtains, polar freezer grade vinyl rolls, anti-static PVC curtains, and stainless steel hanging systems.

- [Products](https://ashmitavinyls.com/product): Comprehensive catalog of industrial PVC strip curtains, polar freezer rolls, and hanging hardware.
- [Categories](https://ashmitavinyls.com/category): Strip curtain rolls, polar grade, ribbed curtains, and hardware collections.
- [About Us](https://ashmitavinyls.com/about): Manufacturing capabilities, quality standards, infrastructure, and nationwide supply.
- [Blog & Guides](https://ashmitavinyls.com/blog): Technical specifications, installation guides, and temperature control insights.
- [Authorized Dealers](https://ashmitavinyls.com/supplier): Distribution centers and authorized dealers across India.
- [Contact](https://ashmitavinyls.com/connect): Request bulk quotations, custom door sizing, and technical consultations.
